title: Workflow
$comment: v1.4. The verified workflow, the core object of Krama (docs/phases/README.md §3.1, docs/database-schema.md).

revision.description: Number of the workflow version whose steps and recording this is (1 = as first recorded). Not the format `version` above.

current_version_source.description: How the current version was made. With status `verified`, `heal` means a self-heal updated it: the `auto-updated` badge (#114, #382). Null for workflows from before versions.

recording_path.description: Relative artifact path to rrweb recording.

steps.description: The ordered sequence of verified steps.

current_version_source.description: How the current version was made. With status `verified`, `heal` means a self-heal updated it: the `auto-updated` badge (#114, #382). Null for workflows from before versions.

last_validated_at.description: When validation last checked it (#135); null if never.

score.description: Only with GET /workflows?q=: relevance x status x freshness (higher first, #135 S5).

match.description: Only with GET /workflows?q=: where the words matched best.

step_seq.description: The step whose text matched best; null when the title or request matched.

snippet.description: Plain text with the matched words wrapped in <mark></mark>. Show it as text plus marks, never as HTML.

WorkflowInput.title: WorkflowInput
WorkflowInput.description: A value the user chooses when Krama runs the workflow for them (#129, P3): one non-sensitive single-line value the recorded run typed. The recorded value is only an example; the user's value replaces it in every step where it reappears.

key.description: Stable name of the input in RunWorkflowRequest.inputs (e.g. repository_name).

label.description: What to ask for, from the field's label (e.g. "Repository name").

example.description: The value the recorded run typed, shown as a placeholder, never as the default.

kind.description: text only in v1; dropdowns replay the recorded option (P15).

pattern.description: A regular expression a value must match: the example's character class (P5), e.g. ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$. Null when any single-line text is accepted.

min_length.description: Shortest value accepted (3 in v1, P5).

steps.description: Seq of every step the value is typed in or reappears in (URL checks, headings, later targets, step text).

WorkflowInputList.title: WorkflowInputList
WorkflowInputList.description: GET /workflows/{id}/inputs: what the owner fills in before "Do it for me" runs the current version.

revision.description: The version the inputs belong to; send it back in RunWorkflowRequest.

account.description: The site account the run will act in. v1: the account Krama is signed in to on that site, not the user's own (P11). Null when unknown.

RunWorkflowRequest.title: RunWorkflowRequest
RunWorkflowRequest.description: POST /workflows/{id}/run: run the workflow's current version for its owner with these values ("Do it for me", #129). Starting it approves the steps; risky steps still pause for confirmation.

revision.description: The version the user previewed (from WorkflowInputList); a newer current version gives 409 stale_revision.

inputs.description: One value per WorkflowInput.key; every input is required (the server checks min_length and pattern).

WorkflowVersionSource.title: WorkflowVersionSource
WorkflowVersionSource.description: What made the version: the first verified run, a self-heal, a regenerated plan, or a human edit.

WorkflowVersionStatus.title: WorkflowVersionStatus
WorkflowVersionStatus.description: current: the one shown. pending_review: waits for the owner to accept it. superseded: an older current one. rejected: the owner turned it down.

parent_version_id.description: The version this one was made from; null for the first.

run_id.description: The run that recorded this version.

change_summary.description: How the steps differ from the parent version; null for the first.

steps.description: Every step of both versions, aligned by meaning, in the new version's order.

StepChangeCategory.title: StepChangeCategory
StepChangeCategory.description: behaviour: what the step does or acts on. check: its expected state. wording: only its instruction text (the UI may collapse these). risk: its risk level.

category.description: The most important category among the changes; null for a same step.

summary.description: Short text for an added or removed step, e.g. 'click button “Confirm”'.

field.description: Dotted path in the step, e.g. target.name, action.value, expected_state.

from.description: The old value (any JSON); absent or null if there was none.

to.description: The new value (any JSON); absent or null if there is none.

ValidationStatus.title: ValidationStatus
ValidationStatus.description: Result of one validation of a stored workflow (docs/research/phase-4-decisions-alignment.md): passed, healed (a new current version), heal_pending (a new version waits for review), outdated, blocked (the environment stopped it; the workflow's status is unchanged), skipped (not replayable).
